name: settleflow
description: Finance-grade payment-platform simulation and engineering case study.

scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const path of ['dist','apps/api/dist','apps/worker/dist','packages/infrastructure/dist','packages/infrastructure/src/generated/prisma','packages/modules/merchant-access/dist']) fs.rmSync(path, { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build: pnpm clean && prisma generate --config prisma.config.mts && tsc --project packages/infrastructure/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project packages/modules/merchant-access/tsconfig.build.json && nest build api && nest build worker
scripts.build:api: prisma generate --config prisma.config.mts && tsc --project packages/infrastructure/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project packages/modules/merchant-access/tsconfig.build.json && nest build api
scripts.build:worker: prisma generate --config prisma.config.mts && tsc --project packages/infrastructure/tsconfig.build.json && nest build worker
scripts.lint: prisma generate --config prisma.config.mts && tsc --project packages/infrastructure/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project packages/modules/merchant-access/tsconfig.build.json && eslint apps packages/infrastructure/src packages/modules test --max-warnings=0
scripts.typecheck: prisma generate --config prisma.config.mts && tsc --project packages/infrastructure/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project packages/modules/merchant-access/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project tsconfig.typecheck.json
scripts.test: prisma generate --config prisma.config.mts && tsc --project packages/infrastructure/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project packages/modules/merchant-access/tsconfig.build.json && jest --selectProjects api worker merchant-access --runInBand
scripts.test:api: prisma generate --config prisma.config.mts && tsc --project packages/infrastructure/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project packages/modules/merchant-access/tsconfig.build.json && jest --selectProjects api --runInBand
scripts.test:worker: prisma generate --config prisma.config.mts && tsc --project packages/infrastructure/tsconfig.build.json && jest --selectProjects worker --runInBand
scripts.test:merchant-access: prisma generate --config prisma.config.mts && tsc --project packages/infrastructure/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project packages/modules/merchant-access/tsconfig.build.json && jest --selectProjects merchant-access --runInBand
scripts.test:integration: prisma generate --config prisma.config.mts && tsc --project packages/infrastructure/tsconfig.build.json && tsc --project packages/modules/merchant-access/tsconfig.build.json && node --experimental-vm-modules ./node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --selectProjects integration --runInBand
